entities.summary: María Isabel Solari Poggio, known as Liz Solari, is an Argentine actress and model. She developed a long career in modeling before becoming established as an actress in local and foreign cinema and television. She is a UNICEF Ambassador in Argentina. Liz Solari was a activists & reformers from Barranquilla (b. 1983-06-18, Barranquilla). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
